prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent RGBA illustration atlas, square canvas. Strict 2x2 arrangement of FOUR separate original explanatory object studies: top-left everyday tote bag with two handles, top-right two unmarked overlapping coin discs, bottom-left shield with one clear check symbol, bottom-right squat iron weight with ring handle. Keep EACH entire subject inside its own quadrant with wide transparent gaps; subjects occupy at most 75% of quadrant width/height. No paper sheet or opaque backing outside the drawing, no page layout, extra objects, hands, people, text, currency signs, numbers, logos, grids or dividers. No copied artwork. Technical pen-and-ink drawing, black ink only. Extremely clean narrow nib contours, curved parallel hatching that follows each object's volume, directional cross-hatching only in deep shadows, crisp white highlights. Controlled intricate structural detail and deliberate open white zones; no gray wash, no charcoal, no pencil smudge. Everyday objects from an observational design sketchbook, not antique engraved plates and not generic flat icons. All marks genuinely ink-like and slightly varied by hand.
